protocol_interfaces.gpu: vortex_physical_top ports: MINI-31 seeded stalls on memory request acceptance and response delivery (both ports); MINI-32 host command response (host_rsp_ready_i) held N cycles per response; MINI-33 reset after 64 busy cycles of the first launch, all DCR writes replayed, launch reissued; stability of every DUT-held handshake checked
protocol_interfaces.cpu: CPU die ports: the UART result stream (serial_source valid/ready) for MINI-31 seeded stalls and MINI-32 per-byte holds, asic_reset_i for MINI-33 (reset 2000 cycles into the record, re-execution after reboot); DFI is a fixed-latency PHY interface without handshake. The target record is placed in image slot 0

power_method: Routed netlist (6_final.v) compiled from Liberty cell functions into a zero-delay two-state event-driven gate model (tools/gatesim, scripts/student_mini_gatesim.py); OpenRAM macros modelled natively; driven by the cycle-by-cycle port trace of the RTL execution of the same workload; every recorded output cycle compared. Pin activity (toggle count, high time) per window written as SAIF and annotated in OpenROAD with the final SDC and SPEF (report_power, tt 25C 1.8V). Accelerators: Icarus gate simulation VCD (existing packages). Engine cross-checked against Verilator SAIF on a ROM bank: identical toggles, 4.30 vs 4.31 mW.

records.source: scripts/export_student_mini_input.py L12-L35; software/include/student_mini_scalar.h L7-L13; integration/litex/bios/student_mini_session.c L29-L35, L49
records.placement: record i at MAIN_RAM_BASE + i*1936 (0x40000000 + i*1936); 1000 baseline records = 1,936,000 bytes; results are kept in student_mini_result and streamed over the UART (not written to DRAM); the protocol tests copy the target record into slot 0
records.header_words: 32 little-endian u32: w0 magic 0x31494e4d, w1 operator, w2 ordinal, w3 seed, w4 query/rows, w5 length, w6 topk, w7 splits, w8 hidden, w9 intermediate, w10 page_size, w11 causal, w12 inject_dma_error, w13 page count, w14-15 expert_ids, w16-24 fp32 scales/route weights (input, gate, up, intermediate, down, score, value, route0, route1), w25-28 primitive witness, w29+ page IDs
records.dma_probe: the CPU writes a descriptor at UNCACHED_DRAM_BASE + 0x200000 and passes MAIN_RAM_BASE + 0x200000 to the accelerator (0x30000000 to inject a DMA fault)

nano_image.segments: 64-byte aligned; weights from offset 0 (attention_ckv 0..), kv_cache_bf16 at 15552 (2048 B), descriptors at 17600 (256 B), operator_scratch at 17856 (1 MiB); image 1,066,432 bytes

physical_top.addressing: mem_req_addr is a 26-bit address of a 512-bit (64-byte) memory line; derived byte address space: 26 + log2(64) = 32 bits
physical_top.port_signals: per port: mem_req_valid/ready/rw, 64-bit byteen, 26-bit addr, 512-bit data, 10-bit tag; mem_rsp_valid/ready, 512-bit data, 10-bit tag, mem_rsp_error (bus error)
physical_top.vector_declaration: per-port 1-bit vectors are declared [0:MEM_PORTS-1] in the RTL; the GPU partition top declares six of them [1:0] (see the gate-power completion replay_port_order)

host_command.port: host_cmd_valid/ready, 2-bit host_cmd_kind, 12-bit host_cmd_addr, 32-bit host_cmd_data; host_rsp_valid/ready, 32-bit host_rsp_data, host_rsp_error

kinds.0: DCR write (addr = DCR address, data = value)

host_command.status_register: DCR read of address 0xFFF (STATUS_ADDR = all ones of the 12-bit address) returns {30'b0, busy, sticky bus fault} without a DCR access
host_command.dcr_space: 12-bit DCR address forwarded to the Vortex core (Vortex DCR map: external Vortex tree, third_party/sources.lock.json "vortex")

memory_adapter.bus_fault: a response with mem_rsp_error sets a sticky per-port fault bit, cleared by the next launch (start); the OR of both ports is the status bus-fault bit
